name: When should I consider repairing my cabinets instead of replacing them?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider repairing my cabinets instead of replacing them?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider repairing your cabinets if the damage is localized, such as minor scratches, dents, loose hinges, or a peeling finish, and the cabinet boxes are still structurally sound. If the overall structure is compromised, or you desire a complete change in layout or style that repairs cannot achieve, then replacement might be a better option. Repairs are often more cost-effective for minor issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair cabinets for minor damage like scratches or loose hinges when the structure is sound; replace for major damage or layout changes.
